product.name: IMAN
product.oneLiner: POS + caja + stock + vencimientos for Argentine kioscos/almacenes. Sold as laser scanner + license 12/24/36 months.
product.market: Argentina small physical stores. ARS. WhatsApp pedidos. WooCommerce pack shop.
product.voice: Spanish, short, floor language. No SaaS English. No ports/localhost in user-facing copy. Speak in product terms.

invariants: Encargado sells and does caja WITHOUT a PIN. Dueño overlay/tab requires owner PIN (4-8 digits).
Phone is a CHECK of the store, not a second till: Vender, Stock, Llego, Vence, Dueno. NO caja on phone. The phone marks a pedido as Llego and can send a ticket to the PC; it never cobra.
PC till is full: Mostrador, Inventario, Pedidos, Caja, Dueño overlay (logo).
Do NOT overwrite a store with a full JSON blob on every scan. Sync is an append-only event tape + snapshot on Sincronizar. The blob save is rev-checked: on a stale rev it merges and retries once.
Do NOT constant-backup every local to the cloud. That kills the 10k ceiling. Chrome wipe recovery = last successful Sincronizar.
City is per-local (settings.city), printed on the ticket. Not a global IMAN city.
One account, several locales (plan seats). Same login for encargado and dueño.
Packs: buy bulto (packBarcode + packQty), sell units (barcode). Stock is always units.
Planilla del mes (Caja) is to SQUARE CASH, not P&L. Ganancias / EBITDA live on Dueño Mes only.
todayKey is LOCAL date, never toISOString().slice(0,10) (UTC shift).
Roles are a PIN gate, not a second user account. Do not add Google/X as a requirement; email login exists.
Manuals are for IMAN sellers and hired support, not the encargado. Spanish. Taller only.
Tauri .exe is LATER. PWA install is the PC app for now.
Hostinger = landing + Woo. POS writes = Neon (or small VPS). Not Hostinger Node for the till.
Vendor claim phrase: SOY EL VENDEDOR (src/lib/plan.ts VENDOR_PHRASE).
Do not invent features, gold-plate, or 'clean up' unrelated code. Founder uses notes-until-GO then GO.
Corrective loop if asked to audit: 1 question requirements 2 delete 3 simplify 4 accelerate. Do not code until GO.
Estudio password lives ONLY in the server env var IMAN_ESTUDIO_PASSWORD. Never in src/, never in git.
Every read-modify-write on the local queue goes through editQueue (src/lib/local-db.ts). Two events in the same tick used to overwrite each other.

payload.persistedRemote: kiosk_store.payload jsonb + rev CAS (saveKiosk on Sincronizar, NOT every keystroke)

events.rule: Devices push events. Never last-write-wins the whole blob over a day's tickets. Snapshot is bootstrapping a new device after sync.
events.cursor: Server-assigned seq (migrations/0015_event_seq.sql). pullEvents takes afterSeq and returns {events, cursor, hasMore}. Device clocks are NOT the cursor: an offline phone pushing old timestamps used to be invisible to the PC.
events.push: Batched (src/lib/event-queue.ts chunk, 200 per call). The device acks only the ids the server returns in `accepted`.

packs.stock: always units; stockBreakdown shows packs + rest
packs.refunds: units; proveedor NC subtracts today's FAC X / FAC A / cigarrillos

ledger.purpose: Cuadrar caja del encargado. Not P&L.
ledger.datoRow: opaque green bg, z-30, bigger type, scroll to today
ledger.rollover: month closes → monthSheets archive on dueño. Q1-Q4. CSV export. releaseMonth frees memory; current month stays.
ledger.defaults: FAC X/A, cigarrillos, caja, virtual, proveedores, total ventas, retiros + 8 empty named gasto rows. NOT Andres/Angie/Duvet.
